item.title: [news] How Circle K accelerated DevOps incident triage to under 15 minutes with Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Circle K's DevOps team cut incident triage from 45-60 minutes to under 15 by building an agentic triage system on Amazon Bedrock.

item.title: [news] Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
item.description: In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automating entire workflows and taking actions based on agent insights.

item.title: [news] Anthropic's internal AI use, at retail prices, now exceeds its employee pay

item.description: AuditFL is a blockchain-backed clearing layer that makes federated learning rounds auditable and economically constrained without removing the aggregator, preserving model accuracy under failures.

item.title: [repo] noah-thing/open-cursor

item.description: SOMA is a benchmark assessing fine-grained egocentric body-motion reasoning in multimodal models, revealing substantial gaps versus human performance and providing training data and a multimodal baseline to advance the field.

item.description: Coding agents use significantly more tokens than basic chat prompts because they iteratively plan, generate code, run tests, and correct errors.

item.title: [paper] SketchDirector: Complex Scene Sketching via Agentic Layout Reasoning and Detail Refinement
item.description: SketchDirector is an agentic framework that decomposes text prompts into draft vector assets, arranges them via iterative reasoning with self-evolving memory, and refines details using diffusion priors for complex scene sketching.

item.title: [paper] No Channels Left Behind: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration through Residual Gates
item.description: Training acceleration in diffusion transformers is driven by reorganization of AdaLN-Zero residual gates, and a simple radial objective promoting broader gate participation improves generation quality without auxiliary teachers.

item.title: [repo] yuanstarstar/dsh-game-stack
item.description: Collection of game assistance and automation plugins featuring game perception, visual entity recall, a rule engine, and a live broadcast bridge for automated gameplay tasks.

item.title: [paper] VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
item.description: A fine-tuned causal target-speaker extraction model achieves near-commercial speech recognition accuracy on real recordings with low CPU usage and latency.

item.title: [paper] MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
item.description: MemSteer generates evidence-grounded QA supervision from unlabeled user histories to optimize agent memory design without model updates, improving benchmark scores significantly.

item.title: [paper] SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
item.description: SciGame evaluates scientific discovery agents using structured cards with counterfactual environments to separate prior knowledge from empirical evidence, revealing that exact symbolic law recovery remains a key challenge.

item.title: [repo] sintetizacom/easycomfee
item.description: Open-source creative studio built on ComfyUI that provides a node-free, prompt-based interface for generating images, videos, visual effects, and audio using open-weight models.

item.title: [paper] Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
item.description: Metis-1.6 introduces small, efficient mixture-of-experts language models trained with limited data that achieve competitive math performance and Pareto-optimal efficiency despite training errors and architectural issues.

item.title: [paper] Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage
item.description: Venus-DefakerOne2 is a unified anti-forgery foundation model that extends detection to diverse forgery forms and media types through alternating LoRA and full-parameter tuning and entropy-based test adaptation.

item.title: [repo] Faixiang/Moodle-MCP
item.description: Moodle-MCP provides a zero-dependency Model Context Protocol server that exposes read-only Moodle course, assignment, quiz, and file tools to AI clients.

item.title: [repo] Banan1cee/whale_gril
item.description: Whale_gril is a Windows desktop chat bot powered by DeepSeek and Qwen that connects large language models to your WeChat account for automated messaging.

item.title: [paper] Supervising the Visible State: Separating Representation from View Selection in Streaming Video
item.description: Visible-State Supervision and Test-Time Causal View Search improve streaming action recognition by separating representation learning from evidence selection, boosting accuracy with fewer frames.

item.title: [paper] GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching
item.description: GLOW-FM is a one-step latent flow-matching framework that enables efficient generative low-light image enhancement via single-function evaluation in a compact latent space.

item.title: [paper] TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation
item.description: TernScope co-designs a compact ternary-weight segmentation network with simplified hardware to achieve high accuracy and fast inference for edge medical imaging.

item.description: Harness Lens compares coding-agent harnesses with every claim linked directly to its original source.

item.title: [model] Edge0/Audio8-TTS-Realistic-Air
item.description: Text-to-speech model from Edge0. 7.3k downloads and 239 likes so far.

item.description: Simon Willison shares a Python dependency troubleshooting tip suggesting the deletion of the uv.lock file when encountering confusing errors.

item.description: Trending on Hacker News from techcrunch.com. 213 points and 210 comments.

item.description: Open-source archive containing categorized legal articles by Baran Dogan to facilitate bulk usage with artificial intelligence tools.

item.title: [repo] SAOS-3624/dsh-see-now
item.description: Real-time screen-capturing plugin that filters frames by visual change and packs them into single images to reduce token usage for AI assistants.

item.title: [repo] ehomekevin/personal-ip-workbench-open-source
item.description: Local-first content creation workbench that helps creators manage source materials, generate multi-platform drafts, and track post-publication data.

item.title: [paper] GazeRIB: Systematic Evaluation of Multi-Reader Gaze-Guided Chest X-ray Learning
item.description: GazeRIB evaluates multi-reader gaze-guided learning for chest X-ray classification, showing that panels of three or more expert readers consistently improve macro F1 and ROC-AUC scores over baselines.

item.title: [paper] Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
item.description: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models proposes LARC, a framework that bridges the modality gap by performing reasoning over continuous hidden states to improve text-to-image generation quality.

item.title: [paper] Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
item.description: Flide is an efficient inference engine that decouples logical decision tree structures from physical execution using ForkAttention, accelerating decision model queries up to 9.5 times.

item.title: [paper] Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
item.description: Latent Sparse Attention is an efficient attention method that clusters keys hierarchically in a latent space, speeding up prefill and decode phases while maintaining accuracy for ultra-long context models.

item.title: [paper] Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
item.description: ID-WM is a hierarchical world model that decouples state-space reachability from local control, improving long-horizon planning and navigation by synthesizing novel plans from short segments.

item.title: [paper] SemEllipsoid: Semantic-aware Shape Abstraction with Ellipsoid
item.description: SemEllipsoid is a semantic-aware shape abstraction method that uses ellipsoidal primitives and semantic constraints to produce 3D shapes that are both geometrically faithful and semantically consistent.

item.title: [paper] RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
item.description: RoboArchitect automates robot harness design by iteratively revising control code around a frozen policy, substantially improving success on unseen scenes and tasks without model updates.

item.title: [paper] Counting on Dummies: Privacy Amplification with Observable Counts and Truncated Batches
item.description: A new privacy mechanism uses dummy points to privatize variable batch sizes and maintain privacy guarantees under truncation in differentially private stochastic gradient descent.

item.title: [paper] ReLift: Dense 3D Tracking as Lifted Trajectory Repair
item.description: ReLift improves dense 3D tracking by repairing and completing lifted trajectories using geometric trajectory refinement without requiring image-based training.

item.title: [paper] A Better Critic Matters for Distribution Matching Distillation
item.description: A study on Distribution Matching Distillation demonstrates that jointly scaling the critic alongside the teacher and using a step-aware critic prevents training collapse and improves few-step image and video generation.

item.title: [paper] Instance-dependent sequential limits as an exact information ledger
item.description: Exact ledger framework that proves instance-dependent sequential limits for bandit regret, sequential tests, best-arm identification, and Markov decision processes, locating the differences between standard algorithms and classical limits across various published sources.

item.title: [paper] DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
item.description: DecisionRank is a decision model trained via item-space on-policy distillation that transfers a generative language model's ranking knowledge to achieve state-of-the-art retrieval performance while running significantly faster.

item.title: [paper] Physiological Trajectories and Observation Patterns in ICU Mortality Prediction: Transportability Under Changing Measurement Conditions
item.description: Study demonstrating that incorporating physiological trajectories into ICU mortality prediction models improves external transportability across different hospital datasets, while observation patterns mainly benefit locally developed models.

item.title: [paper] Gradient Descent on Two ReLU Neurons: Global Landscape and Bifurcation Dynamics
item.description: Theoretical analysis of a two-neuron ReLU teacher-student model trained by gradient descent, showing how the learning dynamics are structured by bisector and splitting directions to produce multi-phase symmetry-breaking behavior.

item.title: [paper] Fast Privacy Loss Accounting for Random Allocation via Multiscale FFT
item.description: Multiscale Fast Fourier Transform algorithm that improves privacy loss accounting for random allocation sampling by reducing the running time dependency on the accuracy parameter and enhancing privacy bounds for private optimization.

item.title: [paper] ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
item.description: ACCT is an asymmetric cross-LLM context transfer method that transforms a source model's key-value cache into sparse states for a different-scale target model, enabling efficient context reuse and reducing computational costs.

item.title: [paper] Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
item.description: Zyphra Hierarchical Attention is an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method that uses a tree-structured indexer over key-value caches to maintain long-context capabilities and reasoning performance while reducing computational scaling.

item.title: [paper] SATFRONT: Detecting Atmospheric Fronts with Satellite Data using Machine Learning
item.description: SATFRONT is a machine learning framework that detects cold, warm, and occluded atmospheric fronts directly from geostationary satellite observations to enable automated frontal analyses for time-critical weather applications.

item.title: [paper] Regret-Optimal Wasserstein-Robust Linear Regression
item.description: Study evaluating distributionally robust optimization for multivariate least-squares regression under Wasserstein perturbations, showing that minimax regret optimization and spectral-norm regularization avoid the suboptimality issues of standard distributionally robust optimization.

item.title: [paper] Hard Constraint Projection in a Physics Informed Neural Network (Burgers)
item.description: Extension of the hard constraint projection method to the nonlinear 1D Burgers' equation, using an unlearnable neural network layer to project velocity predictions directly onto the hyperplane of exact discretized solutions for improved accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Hyperbolic Inverse Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Hyperbolic inverse reinforcement learning parameterizes rewards using hyperbolic distances to improve predictive accuracy and interpretability in human navigation and reinforcement learning benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
item.description: Plasticity-preserving methods increase learning robustness in stochastic deep reinforcement learning environments, with their advantages growing alongside observation noise levels.

item.title: [paper] CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
item.description: Causal World Action Models enforce sparse routing to isolate action-relevant latent variables, ensuring identifiable causal structure without requiring temporal independence assumptions.

item.title: [paper] Rethinking Asymmetry in Self-Supervised 3D Geometry Learning
item.description: Self-supervised 3D geometry learning is improved by imposing asymmetry in the 3D representation space and aligning sparse-context features with dense-context features and vision foundation models.

item.title: [model] nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-NVFP4
item.description: Vision-language model from nvidia. 1.5k downloads and 122 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] Cost-Aware Stopping for Freeze-Thaw Bayesian Optimization: When Does One-Step Lookahead Suffice?
item.description: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization uses a cost-aware one-step lookahead stopping rule based on expected improvement to trade training increments for efficient candidate evaluation.

item.title: [paper] RangeSWA: Training-Free Length Extrapolation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
item.description: RangeSWA is a training-free length extrapolation method that combines local sliding-window attention, remote block summaries, and dynamic content retrieval to improve continuous diffusion language models.

item.title: [repo] Juneo-Lab/decision-forge
item.description: Tool that compiles organizational policies into verifiable decision training data to build trustworthy AI agents.

item.title: [paper] Think in 360°: Benchmarking and Bootstrapping Panoramic Video Reasoning
item.description: PanoVideoReasoner uses a panoramic video benchmark and sphere-time-grounded reasoning datasets to improve cross-view tracking and evidence integration in panoramic video understanding models.

item.title: [paper] Differentially Private Synthetic Data from Sliced Chebyshev Moments
item.description: SPLICE is a differentially private synthetic data algorithm that measures noisy sliced Chebyshev polynomial moments to achieve high-dimensional global distributional guarantees without dimension-dependent error scaling.

item.title: [paper] RAMA: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Routing with Episodic Memory for LEO Satellite Networks
item.description: RAMA is a retrieval-augmented multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework that uses episodic memory and auxiliary objectives to improve scalable decentralized routing in LEO satellite networks.

item.title: [paper] The Knowledge Layer Model (KLM): Evidence-Visible AI Output, Routing Diagnostics, and Negative Results
item.description: The Knowledge Layer Model is an open specification for inference records that provides versioned epistemic assessments, evidence relations, and explicit unknowns for AI outputs.

item.title: [paper] PersonaChatBench: Evaluating Chat Assistants with Diverse Simulated Users
item.description: PersonaChatBench evaluates conversational assistants by pairing fixed tasks with multiple simulated users guided by diverse private persona cards to measure task competence and need fulfillment.

item.title: [paper] CRoS: Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs Improves Accuracy and Reasoning Faithfulness
item.description: CRoS is a chain-of-thought causality metric that perturbs reasoning step order instead of content, improving accuracy, reasoning quality, and faithfulness in language models.

item.title: [paper] REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
item.description: REA is a routed embodied agent runtime that coordinates a deliberative brain, a router, and reactive policies asynchronously without letting fast execution wait on the brain.

item.title: [paper] Exact Theory and Optimal Stepsizes for Stochastic Gradient Descent in Smooth Convex Minimization
item.description: Exact worst-case analysis of stochastic gradient descent in smooth convex minimization provides minimax optimal stepsize schedules and proves their uniqueness under bounded variance.

item.title: [paper] A richness-sensitive Acoustic Biodiversity Index from species-level detections: classifier benchmarking, false-positive control and validation against standard soundscape indices in an African savanna and an urban zoo
item.description: Acoustic Biodiversity Index (ABI_E) uses species-level detections and Shannon diversity to provide an acoustic index that correlates strongly with species richness.

item.title: [paper] Near-Optimal Second-Order Convex Finite-Sum Optimization under Individual Smoothness
item.description: This paper establishes a new lower complexity bound and designs a Taylor-corrected lazy Newton method for smooth convex finite-sum optimization under individual smoothness.

item.title: [paper] Same Question, Different Answers: Auditing Persona-Dependent Variation in Six LLMs on Smoking-Cessation Advice
item.description: An audit of six large language models on smoking-cessation advice reveals that responses vary significantly depending on user personas and demographic attributes.

item.title: [paper] Learning Clean Generative Processes from Noisy Measurements
item.description: A learning method for clean generative models from noisy observations uses Noise2Noise regression and a consistency relation to repair predictions beyond training noise levels.

item.title: [paper] Any Forcing: Any-Step Generality and One-Step Stability for Autoregressive Video Generation
item.description: Any Forcing is an autoregressive video generation framework that uses a unified adversarial discriminator and an adaptive memory selection mechanism to achieve stable one-step generation.

item.title: [paper] There Is No Free Loop: When Does Looping a Trained Model Pay for Its Inference Compute?
item.description: Evaluating looped models across different sizes shows that adding loops to pretrained models only improves performance for small models with fixed parameter budgets.

item.title: [paper] Empirical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Methods for Classification: A Comparative Study with Classical Kernels
item.description: A comparative study of quantum and classical kernel methods reveals that quantum kernels are statistically indistinguishable from tuned RBF kernels when bandwidth is properly tuned.

item.title: [paper] CausalXRL: Explainable Reinforcement Learning through Causal Graph Reasoning
item.description: CausalXRL is an explainable reinforcement learning framework that uses causal graph reasoning to provide structured, multi-level explanations of agent decision-making.

item.title: [paper] A Neural Network Approach towards Real-Time Knot Point Density Estimates for the Nonlinear Quadrotor
item.description: A learning-based method uses a neural network to estimate local trajectory variations and construct adaptive, nonuniform knot distributions for B-spline approximations.

item.title: [paper] GhostPrefix: Synchronization-Free Universal Prefix Attacks for ASR Manipulation
item.description: GhostPrefix is a synchronization-free universal adversarial prefix attack that prepends short audio segments to live speech to control automatic speech recognition outputs in real time.

item.title: [paper] Know When the Equation Is Wrong: Structural Uncertainty for LLM-Guided Symbolic Regression under Extrapolation
item.description: LLM-SR-UQ is an uncertainty quantification framework for symbolic regression that preserves competing equation structures and uses their disagreement to define structural prediction intervals.

item.title: [paper] Asynchronous Flow Map Language Models
item.description: Asynchronous flow map language models incorporate token prediction order into one-step parallel generation by learning flow maps with state-adaptive schedules.

item.title: [paper] When Does Jacobian Fine-Tuning Stabilize Neural PDE Emulators?
item.description: Jacobian fine-tuning stabilizes neural PDE emulators by penalizing the model's error amplification along its own error direction in chaotic physical systems.

item.title: [paper] TurnTurk-GPT: Text-Based Turn-Taking Prediction for Turkish
item.description: TurnTurk-GPT is a text-based turn-taking predictor for Turkish that uses a fine-tuned GPT-2 model to detect end-of-turn cues in verb-final morphology.

item.title: [paper] TradeWar: A Benchmark for Execution-Grounded Trade Negotiation with Adaptive LLM Agents
item.description: TradeWar is a multi-country simulation benchmark that evaluates execution-grounded trade negotiation policies using an economic health index.

item.title: [paper] GeoFlip: Benchmarking Geometry-Sensitive Physics in Video Generation
item.description: GeoFlip is a video generation benchmark that evaluates how effectively models translate geometric changes in initial frames into correct physical outcomes.

item.title: [paper] AutoAnalysis: An automated, self-updating meta-analysis of human-AI collaboration
item.description: AutoAnalysis is an automated, self-updating meta-analysis tool that synthesizes empirical evidence on human-AI collaboration performance across multiple studies and tasks.

item.title: [paper] Less Loss, Fixed Weights: Logit Corrections for Forgetting
item.description: Fixed adjustments to a language model's final token predictions can recover a portion of the performance lost during fine-tuning or pretraining without altering model weights.

item.title: [paper] SecPO: Principled Adversarial Training for Prompt Injection Security
item.description: SecPO is an adversarial training and loss framework that significantly reduces prompt injection success rates in language models and AI agents without harming their general utility.

item.title: [paper] On Statistical-Computational Gaps in Graph Combinatorial Testing Problems
item.description: A study on high-dimensional graph combinatorial testing establishes sharp statistical and computational thresholds and new gaps for signal detection across various graph structures.

item.title: [paper] DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
item.description: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization is a memory configuration method that improves long-context retrieval accuracy in linear attention models without adding trainable parameters.

item.title: [paper] MoETok: Sparse Expert Routing for 1D Visual Tokenizers
item.description: MoETok is a sparse expert routing method for 1D visual tokenizers that uses role-specialized paths to improve image reconstruction, semantic representation, and generation.

item.title: [paper] ID2Pattern: Pretraining Generalizable Identity Behavior Patterns for Transaction Risk Foundation Models
item.description: ID2Pattern is a pretraining framework that encodes identity behavior patterns into discrete sequences to improve transaction risk models and generalize to unseen users.

item.title: [paper] FoAViS: Analyzing Learned Fixation Strategies in a Foveated Active Vision System
item.description: FoAViS is a foveated active vision system that uses learned fixation policies to select task-specific image locations, improving performance on classification and semantic segmentation.

item.title: [paper] TwinPast: Benchmarking Historical Evidence Use in Streaming Video Understanding with Evidence Contrastive Video Pairs
item.description: TwinPast is a benchmarking framework using contrastive video pairs to evaluate whether streaming video models properly use historical visual evidence rather than relying only on recent frames.

item.title: [paper] New Lower Bounds for Private PAC Learning
item.description: A new framework for private PAC learning establishes lower bounds on sample complexity using the Independent Class Packing parameter, yielding tight bounds for several geometric concept classes.

item.title: [paper] When Does Test-Time Search Help World Action Models? An Empirical Audit of Candidate Selection and Simulator Integrity
item.description: An empirical audit of test-time search in world-action models reveals limitations in candidate selection signals, realized speedups, and evaluation integrity due to rendering corruption.

item.title: [paper] Prune Gradually, Adapt Sparsely: Efficient Pruning of Large Language Models at Extreme Sparsity
item.description: ETAPS is a pruning framework for large language models that gradually removes weights in stages and adapts sparsely, achieving lower perplexity and drastically reduced computational cost compared to existing methods.

item.title: [paper] When Is a Game a Markov Decision Process? Correspondences Between Game Theory and Reinforcement Learning
item.description: A new monograph bridges game theory and reinforcement learning by establishing formal mathematical correspondences that prove every standard class of game can be viewed as a Markov decision process.

item.title: [paper] Robust Learning of Multi-Index Models under Logconcave Distributions via Weak Partial Learners
item.description: A new algorithmic framework uses weak partial learners and recursive moment-based partitioning to efficiently and robustly learn Boolean concept classes and multi-index models under logconcave distributions.

item.title: [paper] WASABI: Wasserstein Sampling via Bridge Interpolants
item.description: WASABI is a diffusion model training method that minimizes KL divergence using Wasserstein gradient flows to generate samples from a target Boltzmann distribution using only the energy function.

item.title: [paper] Chronos-2: A foundation model for multivariate time series forecasting
item.description: Chronos-2 is a multivariate time series foundation model that performs zero-shot probabilistic forecasting by modeling interactions between multiple time series and heterogeneous covariates.

item.title: [paper] Shock Loading Accesses Reaction Pathways beyond Accelerated Thermolysis
item.description: EMFF-MACE is a reactive machine-learning potential that enables simulations of energetic materials, revealing that shock loading accesses distinct reaction pathways and structural states compared to thermolysis.

item.title: [paper] Aligning MLLMs with the Latent Structure of Human Cognition via Behavior-Derived Semantic Dimensions
item.description: A novel framework aligns multimodal large language models with human cognitive representations by using behavior-derived semantic dimensions and dimension-grounded linguistic rationales from human similarity judgements.

item.title: [paper] Optimizing Stochastic Policy Geometry for Few-Step Flow Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Geo-FSRL is a geometry-optimized reinforcement learning method for few-step flow models that selects stochastic policies by minimizing a conditional KL divergence geometry factor.

item.title: [paper] Sensorium: An Open-Source Multimodal Data Collection and Curation Library for Embodied Surgical AI
item.description: Sensorium is an open-source Python library for recording, processing, annotating, and curating multimodal surgical data from configurable robot and sensor streams.

item.title: [paper] Observable-Specific Validity Tests for Scientific AI: Controlled Approximations and Intervention Response
item.description: Observable-specific validity records for scientific AI link model reductions to reference models, error measures, and intervention responses to provide checkable guarantees of controlled approximation and physical transfer.

item.title: [paper] Binary Sparse Codes: Where are we on Energy Efficient Representations?
item.description: Metric framework that formalises information preservation as similarity preservation for evaluating binary sparse codes and quantifying the trade-off between sparsity and informational structure.

item.title: [paper] Variance Reduction for Decentralized Stochastic Optimization with Multiple Local Updates
item.description: Primal-dual-based decentralized optimization algorithm that integrates variance reduction with multiple local updates to achieve faster convergence and larger stepsizes while reducing communication costs.

item.title: [paper] IGDA-ICMH: an Importance Guided Feature and Network Dual Adaptation Framework towards Image Compression for Machine and Human Vision
item.description: Importance Guided Feature and Network Dual Adaptation framework that uses implicit neural representations and low-rank adaptation to improve image compression for both machine and human vision.

item.title: [paper] Recommendation Feedback Loops Shape Urban Income Segregation and Venue Visitation
item.description: Long-term simulation framework using fine-grained human mobility data to study how recommender systems and their retraining shape urban income segregation and venue visits.

item.title: [paper] Structure-Aware Skill Retrieval and Arbitration for Optimization Modeling
item.description: ArchOR is an archetype-centric skill agent utilizing centroid-aware representation learning and signature-guided retrieval to improve large language model performance on natural-language optimization tasks.

item.title: [paper] Completeness and Cost of Retrieval Structures for Multi-Tool Requests in LLM Agents
item.description: Study evaluating six retrieval structures across multi-tool testbeds to measure the completeness and computational costs of retrieving required tool sets for large language model agents.
